portability: All project paths are relative to the workspace root. Absolute paths, drive letters, and user-home literals are rejected by the public contract.
resolution_rule: 1) match an alias or keyword in the task text  2) use cwd/discovery  3) leave the project unresolved and report it. Add projects with `eos workspace add` or `python engine/router/new_project.py`.

workspace_index.note: Empty by design. The public package does not ship anybody's project inventory. A workspace fills this index when it adopts the control plane.
